== Biography ==
{{African-American Sticker}}

Azubah was born ca. 1810 and may have died young.  He is the son of [[Glasko-4|Isaac Glasko]] and [[Brayton-597|Lucy Brayton]]. 

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasko-4]] is assessed at 86% (probable). Knoblock’s 2015 African American Historic Burial Grounds and Gravesites of New England p.167 is cited for Azubah’s c.1810 placement with Isaac and Lucy Brayton. Isaac’s family list repeats Azubah, but no original birth/inscription wording is transcribed.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Inspect Knoblock p.167 and its source notes, then the original register.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasko-7 Glenn A.
